messages:
Rina (Design): quick flag from QA — on the compact dashboard the row action menu and a success toast overlap, which made the tester tap the toast instead of the menu item. saw this on an iPhone SE width.
Omar - Eng: ok can you repro steps and attach a gif? which page?
Rina (Design): Models -> List view, narrow width ~320px, open row kebab -> choose quick action that triggers toast (e.g., 'Promote'), toast slides in bottom-right and covers first menu option. gif attached.
Lina (Design Systems): probable cause: compact spacing tokens reduced button padding and our popper dropdown is inside a transformed parent so its stacking gets locked below fixed toasts. also some compact tokens dropped effective hit target below 44px.
Gus (PM): user impact: could lead to accidental toasts (undoable) or failed actions. also copy "Done" on toast is ambiguous here. recommend contextual text: "Promoted to production" or "Promotion scheduled".
Omar - Eng: short-term workaround: when a popper is open, set toast `pointer-events: none` and reduce opacity so taps go through. downside: undo/action buttons on toast become unreachable.
Lina (Design Systems): long-term: 1) reintroduce `--touch-target-min` token = 44px and make compact aliases respect it; 2) update popper to mark open interactive elements with a shield attribute so toast positioning avoids them; 3) avoid using `transform` on wrappers that contain poppers (will-change or translateZ creates new stacking context).
Rina (Design): also accessibility: keyboard focus ring got partially hidden by toast. focus-visible should live above toasts or toasts should not overlap focused elements.
Gus (PM): motion nit: toast animation is 320ms and blocks pointer events during the whole duration — testers tapped mid-animation and triggered the toast. can we shorten to 160-200ms and enable pointer-events only after enter finishes?
Omar - Eng: will prototype: responsive rule to center toasts on viewports <= 420px, add popper-avoid rect, toggle pointer-events post-animation, and add a small z-index bump for focused elements. also will try swapping transform usage to avoid stacking context.
Lina (Design Systems): I'll add a token `--toast-edge-gap` so toasts keep at least `--touch-target-min/2` from edges. will also add a lint that flags tokens that reduce effective hit area under 44px.
qa-bot: opened PR `compact-toast-popover-guard-1733` preview: https://staging.redwood.ai/pr/2555 :white_check_mark:
Omar - Eng: tested on staging (iOS Safari, Android Chrome, desktop narrow). popovers no longer covered, touch targets look better. one remaining micro-overlap during the last 60ms of animation on slow devices; lowering easing fixed it. left screenshots in PR.
Rina (Design): great. follow-ups: update tokens README with `--touch-target-min`, add Percy snapshot for 320/375 widths, and update copy strings to be contextual.
Gus (PM): adding to release notes: "Improved toast placement and touch targets on small screens; clarified success messages." thanks team.
Omar - Eng: merging after CI passes. closing loop once deployed.
Rina (Design): thanks everyone :sparkles:
